A rope tornado was visible from the San Angelo forecast office in Irion County. This tornado was seen by multiple people at different locations.

The public reported only quarter size hail. However, it is possible that the hail may have been larger since some cars had broken windshields. Crops were also severely damaged. Radar indicated hail around baseball size.
Golfball Size hail damaged windows and homes.
The NWS storm survey revealed the tornado snapped tree limbs along Farm to Market Road 853.
A trained spotter reported several large tree limbs down.

Texas Department of Transportation reported hail up to two feet deep at the intersection of FM 2469 and State Highway 163. Most of the hail was the size of a nickel, but there was lots of it. The Sheriff reported hail boulders and a porta-potty floating in the ditch.
